Consuelo OS currently has two skill sources: bundled skills shipped with OS and user-owned local skills.

## Choose bundled skills during setup

The interactive installer asks which skills to enable. Selected bundled skills are materialized under `~/.consuelo/skills` and recorded in `~/.consuelo/config.json`.

A non-interactive `--yes` installation uses the current default selection. There is not yet a standalone public `consuelo skill install <name>` command.

To change the selected bundled set through the supported self-service UI, rerun the interactive installer and choose the desired skills. The installer preserves locally edited bundled skills instead of silently replacing them.

## Add a local skill

A local skill is a folder under:

```text
~/.consuelo/skills/<skill-name>/
```

At minimum it needs a valid `SKILL.md` and `skill.json`. Use the structure in [Create a skill](/build/skills/create-a-skill/) and [Skill structure](/build/skills/skill-structure/).

Run the normal OS provisioning flow after adding the folder so `skills.json` is refreshed. Folders without Consuelo's bundled-install metadata are treated as user owned and preserved on later provisions.

## Verify

Check that:

1. the skill folder exists under `~/.consuelo/skills`;
2. its entry appears in `~/.consuelo/skills/skills.json`;
3. the metadata status is `active`;
4. its referenced guidance entrypoint and tools exist;
5. permission and approval metadata match the manifest when a runtime skill entry is present.

A folder being present does not prove its runtime dependencies are available. Exercise the skill's documented verification step before relying on it.
